label: a map.
why: After a cut at 3.75 s, two men stand at a wall and the man on the left holds a small paper map against it, sliding it into place from 4.0 to 5.0 s and then holding it while both men point at it. The interval starts after the cut and the map stays in frame the whole time; the first shot before 3.75 s is a still drawn map with only a pointer moving.
